typography.notes: Use tracking-tight for headings (text-5xl or text-6xl max). Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Create a professional, heavy-weight feel for the Future Glass marketplace.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Professional Tech/Marketplace)

visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle box-shadows using the primary color to highlight active states and 3D depth. Use drop-shadow on 3D elements.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Use transform -translate-y-1 with increased surface opacity (bg-white/10) and border glow.
visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle noise/grain overlay for a premium, non-flat dark mode feel.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, or p-16 for main containers. Keep internal padding p-6 for cards to avoid text collision.
grids_and_layouts.storefront_grid: The Bento Grid Protocol (MODE A): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gap-8 for storefront product browsing, auctions, and QC reports.
grids_and_layouts.admin_grid: High Density Grid (MODE B): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 for the existing Admin Panel. Preserve functionality.

components.header: Sticky navigation with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). MUST have logo, links, responsive mobile hamburger menu, cart, and customer account actions. DO NOT use fully transparent background.
components.product_cards: Glassmorphism for storefront products and auctions. No generic Shadcn cards for storefront.
components.admin_components: Retain Shadcn standard dense design for the admin panel. Do not overwrite unless required for dark theme consistency.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or crisp sharp edges with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style for the storefront. Admin uses standard Shadcn buttons.
components.forms: Use Shadcn customized components (Inputs, Select) for Checkout, Account Hub, and Orders.

implementation_steps: Hero Section: Embed a `<Canvas>` using `@react-three/fiber`. Render a professional, rotating 3D element (e.g., geometric abstraction or product placeholder).
Lighting: Ensure 3D scenes have adequate lighting. Use Drei's `<Environment>` and `<Float>` to make the object feel premium and alive.

Card Interactions: Implement 3D tilt/perspective effects on Storefront product and auction cards using `framer-motion` (e.g., tracking mouse position and applying `useTransform` to rotateX and rotateY).
Background: Use subtle floating particles or a 2.5D parallax scrolling effect to establish depth without clutter.

motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Entrance animations for hero text.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Button press scale down. Use Framer Motion for organic spring animations, not linear transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Provide high contrast hover states.
accessibility.data_test_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button', data-testid='nav-cart-link', data-testid='auction-bid-btn').
accessibility.focus_states: Focus states must have higher contrast than default, using a 2px solid ring (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a professional 'Future Glass' marketplace theme using deep dark colors (#050505) and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10) for UI surfaces.
Storefront and Product Pages: Incorporate a 3D Canvas with @react-three/fiber for a premium, professional tech vibe in the hero area.
Add Framer Motion 3D tilt effects on product/auction cards to create interactive depth.
Maintain the existing Admin panel layout, ensuring it remains highly functional and dense, while styling it to match the overall dark mode.
Ensure the application covers Customer storefront, mobile navigation, product browsing, Cart, Orders, Auctions, QC reports, checkout, and account hub.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on floating components like headers or dropdown menus.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on ALL interactive and key informational elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use Unsplash URLs provided.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component is located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`.
